title: Recursive pass — Hsiao WEF artifact recovery depth 8
summary: Maximum configured depth resolves Hsiao as a named author of WEF's 2023 Data Equity briefing paper, preserves the unresolved 2021/2024 artifact questions, and emits a distinct new root target for direct Palantir-personnel publication links.

data.research_question: Can the maximum-depth artifact pass resolve direct Hsiao attribution to WEF data-policy outputs?
data.method: WEF publication cross-check plus arXiv author metadata.
classification_rules: Exact authorship is recorded only when named in publication metadata.
2023 Data Equity authorship does not back-propagate to 2021 Pathways authorship.
Council/member status does not imply endorsement of every output.
Max-depth follow-ons become new root targets rather than silently exceeding configured depth.

findings.finding: Katherine Hsiao is directly listed as an author of WEF's 2023 Data Equity briefing paper in arXiv metadata.
The 2021 Pathways and 2024 framework contributor-level questions remain separate artifact-recovery tasks.
